description: Test whether TANC2 IntAct interaction partners are enriched for PDZ-domain proteins, with and without the PDZ-array screen
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, re, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/webservices/psicquic/intact/webservices/current/search/query/id:Q9HCD6",
               params={"format":"tab27"},timeout=180)
rows=[]
for l in r.text.strip().split("\n"):
    f=l.split("\t")
    ga=re.findall(r'uniprotkb:([^(]+)\(gene name\)',f[4]); gb=re.findall(r'uniprotkb:([^(]+)\(gene name\)',f[5])
    ida=f[0].replace("uniprotkb:",""); idb=f[1].replace("uniprotkb:","")
    pm=re.findall(r'pubmed:(\d+)',f[8])
    if "Q9HCD6" in ida: p,pid=(gb[0] if gb else idb), idb
    else: p,pid=(ga[0] if ga else ida), ida
    rows.append({"partner":p,"acc":pid.split("-")[0],"pmid":pm[0] if pm else ""})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df=df[df.partner!="TANC2"]
part=df.groupby("partner")["pmid"].apply(lambda s:set(s)).to_dict()
print("unique partners:",len(part))

# PDZ-domain-containing human proteome (InterPro IPR001478), reviewed
q='https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=(xref:interpro-IPR001478)+AND+(organism_id:9606)+AND+(reviewed:true)&fields=gene_primary&format=tsv&size=500'
t=requests.get(q,timeout=180).text.strip().split("\n")[1:]
pdz=set()
for line in t:
    for g in line.split(";"):
        g=g.strip()
        if g: pdz.add(g.split()[0])
print("human reviewed PDZ proteins:",len(pdz))
BG=20420

allp=set(part)
pdz_all=allp & pdz
# partners supported by at least one study other than the PDZ-array screen 36115835
indep={p for p,s in part.items() if s-{"36115835"}}
pdz_indep=indep & pdz
for lab,S in [("all IntAct partners",allp),("partners w/ non-36115835 evidence",indep)]:
    k=len(S&pdz); n=len(S)
    odds,p=fisher_exact([[k,n-k],[len(pdz)-k,BG-len(pdz)-(n-k)]],alternative="greater")
    print("%-38s n=%3d PDZ=%3d (%.0f%%)  OR=%.1f  p=%.3g"%(lab,n,k,100*k/n,odds,p))

tt=[p for p in allp if re.match(r'^(YWHA[BEGHQZ]|SFN)$',str(p))]
print("\n14-3-3 family partners:",sorted(tt))
print("PDZ partners (all):",sorted(pdz_all))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.5))
cats=["PDZ-domain\nproteins","14-3-3\nfamily","PP1 catalytic\nsubunits","other"]
pp1=[p for p in allp if str(p) in ("PPP1CA","PPP1CC","PPP1CB")]
vals=[len(pdz_all),len(tt),len(pp1),len(allp)-len(pdz_all)-len(tt)-len(pp1)]
ax.bar(cats,vals,color=["#8e44ad","#16a085","#d35400","#bdc3c7"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+1,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel("number of TANC2 interaction partners (IntAct)")
ax.set_title("TANC2 interactome is dominated by PDZ-domain scaffolds\n(%d of %d partners, OR=%.0f vs human proteome)"
             %(len(pdz_all),len(allp),fisher_exact([[len(pdz_all),len(allp)-len(pdz_all)],[len(pdz)-len(pdz_all),BG-len(pdz)-(len(allp)-len(pdz_all))]])[0]),fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
